snippet.title: Volkolak: The Will of Gods - Chapter 2 Trailer
snippet.description: The development team behind the 2D soulslike metroidvania "Volkolak: The Will of Gods" is proud to announce the release of Chapter 2. This update is the most massive since the game's Early Access launch: the volume of new content is comparable to Chapter 1 and "The Darkest Gift" update combined. Notably, with this release, the game is now 80% complete. We are officially on the home stretch!
